items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 15 at 10:54AM AKDT until October 16 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 60 mph. Gusts
up to 75 mph at elevations greater than 500 ft.

* WHERE...Annette Island and Ketchikan Gateway Borough.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...High winds will blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest wind gusts are expected Thursday night
into Friday.
items.instruction:
Report any damage to the National Weather Service by visiting
weather.gov/Juneau/StormReports.

items.description:

half of the panhandle, with the heaviest rain expected late morning
